**Cottage Cheese Pancakes**

List of ingredients :

cottage cheese - 200 gm

semolina - 1/2 cup

sugar - 1/2 cup

eggs -1

vanilla (optional)

fresh fruits (optional)

jam or sour cream (optional)

**Video cooking guide is here** - https://youtu.be/cFZN5WtlGiU

Instructions:

Mix cottage cheese with eggs

Add sugar and semolina (+ vanilla) and mix it all together.

Roll cheese balls and fry them until they get golden.

Serve them up to your taste
